EconomyFile.description: EconomyFile controls initialization, persistence, and respawning for Central Economy subsystems in `db/economy.xml`.

animals.description: Animals controls initialization and persistence of non-ambient wildlife.

building.description: Building controls initialization and persistence of building state, such as randomized or saved door states.

custom.description: Custom controls initialization and persistence for custom CE entities.

dynamic.description: Dynamic controls CE initialization, persistence, and respawning for dynamic economy entities such as world loot.

economy.description: XMLName identifies the required `<economy>` document root.

player.description: Player controls initialization and persistence of player CE state.

randoms.description: Randoms controls initialization and persistence for random economy entities.

vehicles.description: Vehicles controls initialization and persistence of CE-managed vehicles.

zombies.description: Zombies controls initialization and persistence of infected entities.

EconomySection.description: EconomySection selects which lifecycle operations Central Economy performs for one subsystem: initialization, loading and saving persistent state, and runtime respawning.

init.description: Init allows CE to initialize this subsystem when the mission starts.

load.description: Load allows CE to restore this subsystem's saved state from server storage.

respawn.description: Respawn allows CE to replenish entities managed by this subsystem during runtime.

save.description: Save allows CE to write this subsystem's state to server storage.
